description: Source code for DNS query handling, including construction, parsing, and management of DNS query packets, with focus on question section and optional EDNS padding.

classes.name: DnsQuery
classes.description: Class representing a DNS query packet, including construction, parsing, cloning, and access to query fields.

methods.name: DnsQuery
methods.description: Constructor to create a DNS query with specified ID, question name, type, optional EDNS data, and padding strategy.

methods.name: DnsQuery::Parse
methods.description: Parses raw buffer data to initialize DNS query fields.

methods.name: DnsQuery::CloneWithNewId
methods.description: Creates a copy of the DNS query with a new ID.

methods.name: DnsQuery::qname
methods.description: Returns the question name as a byte span.

methods.name: DnsQuery::question
methods.description: Returns the question section as a string piece.

methods.name: DnsQuery::question_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the question section.

methods.name: DnsQuery::set_flags
methods.description: Sets the flags field in the DNS header.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from another DnsQuery instance.

methods.name: ReadHeader
methods.description: Reads DNS header fields from a big-endian reader.

methods.name: ReadName
methods.description: Reads a domain name from a big-endian reader.
